language_task: Pick up the ball and place it in the bowl.
outcome_evidence: The orange ball starts beside the blue bowl (frame 0, camera_high). The robot acquires and lifts the ball, visibly retained between the fingers during transport (frames 165–200, camera_wrist_right and camera_wrist_left). It positions the ball over the bowl and releases it inside (frames 245–283, camera_wrist_right). The gripper withdraws empty, leaving the ball in the bowl (frames 318–350, camera_high); the ball remains there through frame 749. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
